mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2pp year-over-year, it signals a supply-side slowdown that will weigh on economic growth and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth slows >2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and compress equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals an overextended housing market that will soon reverse, leading to a demand-side slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth > 10% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% year-over-year, it signals a weakening labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y PAYEMS growth slows >1pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a consumer spending slowdown that will weigh on economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y RSAFS growth slows >2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3%, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will prompt the Fed to tighten monetary policy, leading to a slowdown in economic growth and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
